items.title: 50% exam voucher for AWS Certified individuals
items.summary: AWS lists a 50% exam-discount voucher among its certification-holder benefits. Check your AWS Certification account for your voucher and its terms.
items.eligibility: Requires AWS Certified status and an available benefit voucher; this is not a public coupon code or a free exam.
items.expiry_note: Individual voucher validity and restrictions apply; check your account.

items.title: DP-700 exam content update scheduled for October 19
items.summary: Microsoft lists an October 19, 2026 update for the English-language Fabric Data Engineer Associate exam. Review the official study guide before preparing.

items.title: Advanced Networking Specialty retires December 31, 2026
items.summary: AWS marks Advanced Networking Specialty as retiring December 31, 2026. Check official availability and policy before scheduling.

items.title: Professional Agentic Architect is listed in beta
items.summary: Google Cloud lists Agentic Architect as a professional beta certification. Check the official page for current registration and beta conditions.

items.title: Context Engineer Associate is in the Databricks catalog
items.summary: The official Databricks certification catalog includes Context Engineer Associate, covering context for AI agent systems. This item records catalog availability, not an inferred launch date.
